title: Twin Choice
next_chapter_hook: Just as Chen Ji was wavering in his decision, Ling Yuan's cold voice echoed from beyond the Tianji Record: "Chen Ji, this old man has been waiting for you for quite some time." The twin choice of destiny was abruptly interrupted—and the true test had only just begun.

text.content: The fluctuations deep within the Tianji Record surged like hidden currents in the abyss, relentlessly battering Chen Ji's consciousness. This was no ordinary power fluctuation—it was the will of the Heavenly Eye, like an invisible giant eye peering through the river of destiny, quietly observing him. "It has found me." Chen Ji murmured, his fingertips tracing across the cover of the Tianji Record. The symbols on the fragmented page glowed faintly, as if responding to some ancient summoning.

dialogue.content: At that moment, a darkness-as-ink aura seeped out from the depths of the Tianji Record, forming a vague silhouette. The figure bore a striking resemblance to Chen Ji, yet radiated an aura of demonic energy—the Demonic Path Commander. "Twin of destiny, we meet again." The Demonic Path Commander's voice carried a hint of languor, "Do you realize we were once one?"

text.content: Chen Ji's pupils contracted slightly, yet he remained composed. He coldly regarded the figure, a hint of mockery curling at his lips: "One? Our paths diverge, so how can we be one?" Yet his mind raced—the twin of destiny, a legendary existence he had only vaguely heard of in Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul, never imagining it would be connected to himself.

dialogue.content: The Demonic Path Commander chuckled, his laughter echoing like a reverberation from an abyss: "In ancient times, before heaven and destiny were separated, we were two souls sharing one essence. One soul controlled the Heavenly Secrets, governing fate and destiny; the other commanded the Demonic Path, ruling over slaughter. Later, the Heavenly Dao forcibly severed us, turning us into bitter, irreconcilable opponents." He stepped forward, "Now the Heavenly Eye descends once more, seeking our total annihilation. Do you truly believe you alone can withstand?"

text.content: The first page of the Tianji Record quivered as Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul materialized. His gaze flickered between the Demonic Path Commander and Chen Ji, before finally letting out a deep sigh: "What he says holds truth. Before the Heavenly Eye's grand design, the Tianji Record and the Demonic Path shared the same origin. That separation... was the Heavenly Dao's first purge against the seers." Mo Xiansheng's voice carried the weight of ages, "You both are pieces abandoned by the heavens after being chosen."

dialogue.content: Chen Ji fell silent for a moment, then abruptly let out a cold laugh: "What grand ambitions. So what if it's the Heavenly Eye? Everyone I've encountered along my path assumed I was destined to die." He lifted his head, his eyes glinting with a cold light, "Your so-called 'fusion' is merely asking me to surrender my consciousness and become your sustenance. Tell me, after the fusion, who will dominate—you or me?"

text.content: The Demonic Path Commander remained unruffled, instead wearing an expression of admiration: "Indeed, Chen Ji—you've proven yourself worthy of reaching this point. Correct, fusion carries risks—success means we merge into one, transcending the Heavenly Dao; failure means mutual annihilation, with both souls destroyed." His form began to blur, "But are you aware of the consequences of refusal? The Heavenly Eye has already marked you. The next encounter will be your last."

choice.prompt: The Demonic Path Commander's proposal echoed in his ears, forcing Chen Ji to make a choice—a pivotal decision that would determine the very course of his destiny.

choices.description: Choose to fuse with the Demonic Path Commander, risking everything for the possibility of transcending the Heavenly Dao. Success means merging into one entity; failure means mutual soul annihilation.
choices.visible_cost: Risk of losing independent consciousness; failure leads to eternal damnation
choices.visible_reward: Fusion with the Demonic Path Commander's power may break through Heavenly Dao shackles
choices.risk_hint: Success rate unknown, and the dominant entity after fusion remains uncertain

text.content: Chen Ji closed his eyes, taking a deep breath. He recalled his missing sister Chen Nian, those who perished by his schemes, and the mission bestowed upon him by the Tianji Record. "If fusion can shatter this wretched fate..." His eyes snapped open, blazing with determination, "I accept." The moment the words fell, the Demonic Path Commander's form lunged towards him, two consciousnesses interweaving in an instant—the searing agony of soul-rending pain nearly shattering Chen Ji's awareness.

choices.description: Refuse fusion with the Demonic Path Commander, continuing to stand alone against the Heavenly Eye. Even if the path leads to death, he will seize control of his own destiny.
choices.visible_cost: Face the Heavenly Eye's pursuit alone, losing a powerful potential ally
choices.visible_reward: Preserve independent consciousness and retain all hidden cards
choices.risk_hint: The Heavenly Eye's targeting will intensify, the next encounter will be a fight to the death

text.content: Chen Ji stepped back sharply, spiritual energy surging around him. Fixing his gaze on the Demonic Path Commander, he spoke each word with precision: "Chen Ji's fate has never been and will never be determined by others." His voice was cold yet resolute, "Even the Heavenly Eye, even destiny itself—if they want my life, they'll have to show some real skill." Raising the Tianji Record in his hand, the fragmented symbols blazed with blinding light, "Fusion? Perhaps in the next life."

choices.description: Refrain from making a final decision, first observing how the situation develops. Keep both fusion and independence as potential paths forward.
choices.visible_cost: May provoke the Demonic Path Commander, creating rifts in their relationship
choices.visible_reward: Buy precious time to secretly investigate more information
choices.risk_hint: The Demonic Path commander might change his attitude, even turning hostile

text.content: Chen Ji fell silent for a long while, the light in his eyes flickering uncertainly. Finally, he spoke slowly: "Your proposal, I will consider." The Demonic Path commander's form slightly froze, clearly dissatisfied with this answer. Chen Ji continued: "But before that, I need to confirm one thing—after fusion, will you and I still exist?" Without waiting for an answer, he turned and walked toward the depths of the Tianji Record. "Three days later, I'll give you my answer."

Just then, the world beyond the Tianji Record suddenly changed color. A massive pressure seeped in from the outside, descending like Heavenly Wrath, irresistible. Chen Ji's expression slightly changed—this pressure, he was all too familiar with. "Ling Yuan!" he hissed. The old sect master who had been lurking in the shadows all along, had finally made his move at this moment.

dialogue.content: The seal of the Tianji Record was torn apart by brute force, and Ling Yuan's figure appeared beyond the rift. His gaze swept over the Demonic Path commander, then looked at Chen Ji, a cold smile curling his lips: "Destiny's Twin Sons? Interesting." An aura belonging to the peak strong one of the older generation radiated from his body. "Chen Ji, this old man has waited for this day for a very long time. Back then, the Tianji Record chose you instead of me. Today, let this old man personally end this karmic debt!"

text.content: Chen Ji felt an suffocating pressure envelop his entire body. Ling Yuan's strength was far more terrifying than he had previously shown. This old fox had hidden himself too deeply. Yet Chen Ji showed no panic; a hint of playful smile even appeared at the corner of his mouth: "Ling Sect Master, such great fury. But are you certain now is a good time to make a move?" His gaze meaningfully fell on the Demonic Path commander. "Two against one, have you thought this through?"

dialogue.content: The Demonic Path commander's form slightly swayed as he let out a low, grim laugh: "Interesting, it seems our 'brother' doesn't want me to die after all." He looked at Ling Yuan, bloodthirsty light flickering in his eyes. "Old man, are you certain you want to make enemies of us here? Once we three go to war, this entire realm will be destroyed. Are you prepared for that?"

choice.prompt: A three-way standoff had formed. Chen Ji had to make a decision—whether to ally with the Demonic Path commander against Ling Yuan, or seize the chaos to escape alone.

choices.description: Temporarily set aside grievances with the Demonic Path commander, unite to kill this threat Ling Yuan first. The enemy of my enemy is my friend.
choices.visible_cost: Owe a favor to the Demonic Path commander, may become passive later
choices.visible_reward: Temporarily eliminate the Ling Yuan threat, preserve oneself
choices.risk_hint: The Demonic Path commander's strength is unfathomable, may take advantage of the situation

text.content: Chen Ji coldly smiled, his form flashing as he stood shoulder to shoulder with the Demonic Path commander. "Ling Sect Master, our grudge can be settled slowly, but today—" He raised the Tianji Record in his hand, the runes blazing brightly. "I'll send you on your way first, together with this 'brother' of mine." The Demonic Path commander let out a hearty laugh: "Satisfying! Chen Ji, you're far more interesting than I imagined!" Two terrifying auras intertwined, pressing toward Ling Yuan.

choices.description: Don't participate in the struggle between the two sides, quietly depart while they confront each other. Preserve strength, watch and wait.
choices.visible_cost: May offend both Ling Yuan and the Demonic Path commander
choices.visible_reward: Preserve strength, avoid being caught in the chaos
choices.risk_hint: Both sides may consider him a traitor

text.content: Chen Ji's eyes flickered as his body quietly retreated. At the moment Ling Yuan and the Demonic Path commander confronted each other, he activated the concealment technique of the Tianji Record, his entire person dissolving into the void and vanishing. Ling Yuan and the Demonic Path commander simultaneously froze, then cold intent appeared in both their gazes. "Interesting." The Demonic Path commander softly said. "This 'brother' of ours is more cautious than we imagined." Ling Yuan冷哼一声："跑得了吗？"

However, Ling Yuan did not immediately strike. His gaze swept between Chen Ji and the Demonic Path commander, then suddenly burst into laughter: "Good! Good! Good!" He said 'good' three times in succession. "Destiny's Twin Sons, Tianji Record and Demonic Path sharing the same origin—this old man has waited too long for this moment." His aura suddenly收敛, yet the killing intent in his eyes intensified. "But this old man has suddenly changed his mind."

dialogue.content: Ling Yuan's figure suddenly retreated, vanishing into the void. His voice drifted from the distance, carrying a诡异smile: "Chen Ji, this old man won't kill you. I want to see how far you two destiny-bound twins can go." His laughter grew more distant. "The next time we meet, either you kill the Demonic Path commander and become the true Tianji successor; or the Demonic Path commander devours you, unifying the two lineages. Whichever outcome—" His voice abruptly cut off. "This old man looks forward to it."

text.content: After Ling Yuan departed, the interior of the Tianji Record returned to peace once more. The Demonic Path commander's form slowly solidified. He looked at Chen Ji, his eyes carrying a more complex meaning: "It seems our 'father' is more patient than we imagined." He softly said. "But what he said isn't wrong either. The two of us, in the end, must determine a victor." His form began to dissipate. "The next time we meet, either fusion, or a battle to the death. You, think about it carefully."

After the Demonic Path commander's form completely vanished, Chen Ji stood alone in the space of the Tianji Record, silent for a long while. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul slowly emerged, speaking softly: "Master, what do you intend to do?" Chen Ji raised his head, his gaze profound: "How much of what Ling Yuan said do you believe?" Mo Xiansheng shook his head: "What he said was not false, but he also held something back. The existence of destiny's twin sons is true, but the choice between fusion and independence lies not with others, but with what you yourself want."

dialogue.content: Chen Ji suddenly smiled, that smile carrying a hint of cold intent: "They all want to watch my show, want to see me become their chess piece." He slowly clenched his fist. "Unfortunately, this Chen Ji never plays by the rules." He turned to gaze into the depths of the Tianji Record, cold light flickering in his eyes. "Ling Yuan wants to watch us destroy each other? Then I'll do the opposite. The Demonic Path commander wants fusion? Fine, but I have one condition."

text.content: Just as Chen Ji was lost in thought, the Tianji Record suddenly surged with intense fluctuations. A familiar figure burst in from outside—it was Su Qingyao. Her face was pale, clearly having forced her way in. "Chen Ji!" Upon seeing that Chen Ji was unharmed, she visibly relaxed. "Ling Yuan has emerged from seclusion, and the entire Tianqing Sect is under his control. You must leave immediately!" Her eyes were filled with anxiety. "I've already informed Ye Qing—she's waiting for you outside the sect."

Chen Ji gazed at Su Qingyao, warmth swelling in his heart. This woman who had always been investigating him was now risking her life to rescue him. He softly said, "Senior Su, you shouldn't have come." Su Qingyao snorted coldly, "Enough talk. Ling Yuan has already noticed I'm gone—he'll be on our trail in less than the time it takes to burn a stick of incense." She grabbed Chen Ji's arm. "Are we leaving or not?" Chen Ji looked at her, then suddenly revealed a meaningful smile. "Leaving? Of course we're leaving. However, before we go—" He turned to look toward the depths of the Tianji Record. "I need to take something with me."
